querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_compcode,
                                      statement_type,
                                      iflisted_data,
                                      report_period,
                                      s_fa_eps_diluted,
                                      s_fa_bps_sh,
                                      s_fa_bps_adjust,
                                      roe_diluted,
                                      s_info_div,
                                      ann_dt,
                                      s_fa_eps_ex,
                                      roe_weighted,
                                      roe_exweighted,
                                      s_fa_eps_basic,
                                      s_fa_eps_exbasic,
                                      roe_ex,
                                      s_fa_deductedprofit,
                                      s_fa_current,
                                      s_fa_quick,
                                      s_fa_arturn,
                                      s_fa_invturn,
                                      s_ft_debttoassets,
                                      s_fa_ocfps,
                                      net_profit,
                                      rd_expense,
                                      s_fa_eps_diluted2,
                                      s_fa_eps_exdiluted,
                                      s_fa_bps,
                                      s_fa_extraordinary,
                                      s_fa_tot_assets,
                                      s_fa_yoyeps_basic,
                                      s_fa_yoyeps_diluted,
                                      s_fa_yoyequity,
                                      growth_bps_sh,
                                      s_fa_yoyocfps,
                                      yoy_net_cash_flows,
                                      s_fa_deductedprofit_yoy,
                                      yoy_roe_diluted,
                                      s_fa_yoyop,
                                      s_fa_yoyebt,
                                      net_profit_yoy,
                                      crncy_code,
                                      statement_type_code,
                                      contributionps,
                                      memo,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_cbondimportantindicators.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.cbondimportantindicators WHERE report_period BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
